category_title: Students with ASD exhibiting inappropriate physical contact and out-of-seat behavior
scenario_title: Out-of-seat behavior during teaching time and transitions
minimal_context: Matthew is transitioning from a reinforcing activity back to his desk for a formal teaching session in the classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Matthew, you have finished accessing your reinforcing activity. Please return to your seat for our teaching time.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands up from the activity area but does not return to his seat, walking to another part of the classroom instead.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Matthew, it is time to sit at your desk.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues to wander around the room, demonstrating out-of-seat behavior during the scheduled teaching time.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please come back to your seat so we can begin.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Leaves the teaching area completely without permission, continuing his out-of-seat behavior which disrupts the session.)

task.content: Formal teaching time and transitioning in the school building

context.environment: General classroom learning environment during daily teaching sessions
context.materials: Curriculum targets, behavior contract, green, orange, and red stickers
context.time_context: Daily teaching sessions, including post-reinforcement periods

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: After transitioning in the school building or finishing accessing a reinforcing activity
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Leaving his seat without permission, not returning to his seat once he finished accessing a reinforcing activity or not returning to his seat after transitioning

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Out-of-seat behaviour ranging from zero to 36 minutes with a mean of 13 minutes per session
